instructions: Follow AGENTS.md. Greptile's review is advice, never a required check.

rules.rule: Traced code feeds the compiled graphs and compile-cache keys: review it for correctness only, never suggest formatting, renames or comment edits, and ask for tools/graph_equiv.py or device evidence when it changes (AGENTS.md, invariant 1).
API handlers hand work to the engine thread through its inbox and never mutate the scheduler or pools directly; an unsupported request field is refused with a 400 that says why.
